🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (score: 9)
Channel: alert-system (synthetic, DD-monitor-sourced; degraded cycle, no Slack MCP)  •  bug-type guess: env  •  alerts in group: 2
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin`

Symptoms:
  • Gateway (ms-gateway-api) P95 latency spiked to 29.83s (threshold 1.5s) at 07:32:30Z
  • ms-identity-api P95 latency spiked to 38.22s (threshold 1.5s) at 07:33:10Z — both share the identical 29.83s reading at the identical timestamp 07:32:30Z
  • Gateway Ocelot layer logged RequestTimedOutError (TaskCanceledException, 90s HttpClient.Timeout) proxying to /identity/memberships at 07:31:48Z and 07:32:46Z
  • ms-identity-api logged one "Unexpected Exception Occurred" at 07:31:58Z, mid-spike
  • Episode spanned ~07:26:00Z–07:57:40Z (~32min), fully self-recovered by scan time

Trace IDs: n/a — degraded mode, no request/trace id captured in the ES sample beyond requestId 0HNN6BN4FV1P0/0HNN6BKI8RNUF
Likely cause: ms-identity-api's /identity/memberships endpoint became slow/hung for ~30min, causing the gateway's Ocelot reverse-proxy layer to time out waiting for it — critical-path (ms-gateway-api) cascade. Root trigger inside ms-identity-api not identified this cycle (repo not fetched, time-constrained).
Suggested next action: page DB/service on-call to check ms-identity-api /identity/memberships for a slow-query or GC-pause issue during 07:26–07:58Z; file a defect

  • 3x "Rainforest API create payment method payin request failed" + 3x "Rainforest Subscription Payment Processing Failed" on runtime-core-api in the window
  • Rejected the closest existing KB match (ki-2026-07-06-rainforest-merchant-details-503-serviceunavailable) — 0 ES hits for its specific "Merchant Details Retrieval Failed" signature; this is a distinct Rainforest-API failure mode

Likely cause: third-party Rainforest payment API returned failures for payment-method-creation and subscription-payment-processing calls for a brief window — consistent with the broader "Rainforest third-party dependency flakiness" theme but a distinct specific signature from existing KB entries.
Suggested next action: monitor / file a defect to consider a single umbrella KB entry for Rainforest third-party API flakiness (payin-failure, subscription-failure, merchant-details-503, outbound-p95-latency now four related-but-distinct signatures)
